scope: Scottsdale service-area page of Camelback Moving, Arizona; not a separate business called Scottsdale Movers.

metrics.label: Founded / company-reported
metrics.context: Reported on the public website; not independently audited.

metrics.label: Scottsdale weekday / two movers
metrics.context: Standard posted rate, two-hour minimum. Trip charge and card surcharge separate; not an all-in quote.

observations.title: Turn the time-estimate worksheet into a phone-friendly tool
observations.observed: The navigation's Moving Time Estimator opens a one-page PDF with home sizes and additions for stairs, elevators, long carries and other conditions.
observations.improvement: Test an accessible web version with a few questions and a labelled planning range that carries into the quote request. Retain the printable PDF.

observations.title: Use local expertise in the first enquiry
observations.observed: The Scottsdale page explains gated communities and building move windows. Its visible quote form asks for service, name, email and phone, without move-date or access questions.
observations.improvement: Test optional date, ZIP and gate/elevator questions. First ask how the team currently collects those details before proposing internal automation.

limitations: The short quote form may be intentional. Test extra questions against completion and lead quality.
The posted rate is not an all-in quote; promotional rates and other charges are described separately.
Public website review only. No forms submitted or mobile-usability, conversion, speed or internal-system tests performed.
